name: Indexer
tip: An indexer answers 'where can I find npub X'. It holds addresses, never other people's posts — a phone book, not a library.

children.name: live
children.tip: Tap 'Volunteer' to cycle: off, only when plugged in, always.

children.name: volunteer
children.label: Volunteer this device
children.tip: Off, when plugged in, or always. Revoking is as easy as granting.

name: The network
tip: Other indexers this device knows — and the leaves it deliberately leaves alone.

children.name: network
children.tip: Leaves announce, get indexed, and are never woken. That asymmetry is why the role exists.
